756670101.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}! Do you have a moment? I've got a story I want to share...

756670103.text: It's about traveling, friends, and family.

756670104.text: In the People of the Springs, there was once a famous traveler by the name of Akamai.

756670105.text: Together with his Koholasaurus companion, Kau Kau, he embarked on a long journey. Their quest: To traverse all of Natlan and feast on all its delicacies.

756670106.text: Whenever they arrived somewhere new, Akamai and Kau Kau would search for the most beautiful stone around to keep as a memento.

756670107.text: Their culinary journey brought them to countless places, filled their backpacks with innumerable beautiful stones, and stuffed their bellies with myriad delectable dishes.

756670108.text: Legend has it that by the time they made it back to the People of the Springs, Akamai was as portly as yours truly.

756670109.text: But that's all by the by. The crux of this preamble is that the duo encountered many wonderful tales on their travels.

756670110.text: #{NICKNAME}, if your ears are ready to listen, I'd be more than happy to share all these happenings with you!

756670111.text: I assure you, you won't regret taking the time to stop and listen!
